name: Yurameku Kokoro ni Michita Sekai de, Kimi no Yume to Yokubou wa Kanau ka
original_name: ゆらめく心に満ちた世界で、君の夢と欲望は叶うか
source:
Starting this fall, Aoi will be attending a boarding school located on a distant Southern island where his father once taught at. Since all the preparations were ready, it was decided that he would move in to the school dormitory during the summer break. The island is only accessible by boat, and he was caught in a storm on the way there, but he somehow made it.

Even though it was the summer break, there were still three girls who remained in the dormitory: the mischievous free spirit Sumire, the kind and cheerful Tsukino, and the cool and outwardly dependable Konoha. Moreover, his imouto Tomoe, who loves to dote on and also be doted upon by him, followed him to the island to prevent him from attending the school.

The days on the island were full of fun and excitement. They showed him around the island, swam in the sea, did some preparation studying, and spent time in the library on rainy days. Every day was full of things to do.

However, the summer break doesn’t seem to be ending. When Aoi became aware of this, he set out to search for the island’s secret….

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/11/08/november-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
从今年秋天开始，葵将就读位于遥远的南部岛屿上的一所寄宿学校，他的父亲曾在那里任教。既然一切准备工作都准备好了，就决定暑假期间他就搬进学校宿舍。这个岛只能乘船到达，他在去那里的途中遭遇了暴风雨，但他还是成功了。

虽然是暑假，宿舍里还留着三个女孩：调皮自由的堇，善良开朗的月野，以及外表冷静可靠的木叶。而且，喜欢宠他、也被他宠的妹妹友惠，为了阻止他上学而尾随他来到岛上。

在岛上的日子充满了乐趣和兴奋。他们带他环岛一周，在海里游泳，做一些准备学习，并在雨天在图书馆度过时光。每天都充满了要做的事情。

然而，暑假似乎还没有结束。当葵意识到这一点后，他开始寻找岛上的秘密……。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/11/08/november-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
